name: epiq
description: EPIQ - ergonomic, distributed CLI-first issue tracker TUI ready for the agentic era

scripts.build:gui: npm run build:gui:types && mkdir -p dist/gui && cp source/gui/index.html dist/gui/index.html && cp source/gui/favicon.ico dist/gui/favicon.ico && esbuild source/gui/client/main.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/gui/main.js
scripts.build:npm: node source/scripts/write-version.mjs && rm -rf ./dist && npm run build:gui && esbuild source/Index.tsx --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && esbuild source/mcp/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --outfile=dist/mcp.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node'
scripts.test:e2e:ci: export IS_CI=true && npm run build:npm && vitest run source/test/e2e
scripts.test:e2e: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -v /app/node_modules -w /app epiq-e2e npm run test:e2e:ci
scripts.pack:check: rm -f epiq-*.tgz && npm pack && FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && echo "$FILE" && tar -tf "$FILE"
scripts.publish:dry: rm -f epiq-*.tgz && npm pack && FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && npm publish --dry-run "$FILE"
scripts.publish:tarball: FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && echo "Publishing $FILE" && npm publish "$FILE"
scripts.release: npm run pack:check && npm run publish:tarball
